text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We did it…… We won together……!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I cheered my hardest... And then, one of 
my teammates...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They told me, 'I heard your voice, and it 
gave me strength.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if Rice was able to help out 
the team, even just a little bit."
